derivation: A = distinct machines in shift_output {M1,M2,M3,M4}; B = distinct machines in machine_status {M1,M2}; C = distinct machines in inspections {M1,M2,M3,NULL}; R = registry {M1..M5}. A UNION B removes duplicates -> 4 rows; A UNION ALL B keeps them -> 6 rows; A INTERSECT B -> M1, M2; R EXCEPT A -> M5; C UNION B -> M1, M2, M3, NULL with NULL appearing once because set operators group NULLs together; C EXCEPT R -> the NULL only; C INTERSECT R -> M1, M2, M3. Positional trap: the second branch lists plant before machine_id, so South rows arrive with the columns swapped and no error. Results are listed in sorted order with NULL first.
